{{Biathlon at the 2026 Winter Olympics}}
The '''men's relay''' competition of the [[Biathlon at the 2026 Winter Olympics|2026 Winter Olympics]] was held on 17 February,<!-- 2026--> at the [[South Tyrol Arena|Anterselva Biathlon Arena]] in [[Rasen-Antholz]].<ref name=olympicresults>{{cite web |title=Men's relay |url=https://www.olympics.com/en/milano-cortina-2026/results/bth/te/m/4x7.5km-----------/fnl-/000100--/race-result |website=Olympics |access-date=17 February 2026}}</ref> France, represented by [[Fabien Claude]], [[Émilien Jacquelin]], [[Quentin Fillon Maillet]], and [[Éric Perrot]], won the event. Norway were second and Sweden third.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.nbcolympics.com/news/france-scores-mens-4x75km-relay-gold-biathlon-showdown|title=France scores men's 4x7.5km relay gold in biathlon showdown|publisher=NBC Olympics|accessdate=27 February 2026}}</ref><ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.espn.co.uk/olympics/story/_/id/47955590/france-upsets-norway-1st-men-biathlon-relay-olympic-gold|title=France upsets Norway for 1st men's biathlon relay Olympic gold|publisher=ESPN|accessdate=27 February 2026}}</ref>

==Background==
Norway were the defending champions, and France were the 2022 silver medalist. The bronze medalist, Russian Olympic Committee, were barred from participation in 2026 due to the military aggression of Russia against Ukraine. Prior to the Olympics, there were four men's relay competitions in the [[2025–26 Biathlon World Cup]]. Three were won by Norway and one by France. Norway were also the [[Biathlon World Championships 2025 – Men's relay|2025 World champions]].
